name: Elon (Hittite)
title: Hittite, father-in-law to Esau
summary: Elon was a Hittite whose daughter Bashemath (Ada) became one of Esau's wives. He is mentioned in connection with Esau's marriage to Canaanite women.

keyEvents.title: Esau's father-in-law
keyEvents.description: Esau married Bashemath, the daughter of the Hittite Elon.
